title: Custom Supernatant Removal and PrestoBlue Test
author: Opentrons
materials: P300 8-Channel Pipette (GEN2) will pick up tips.
Steps 1-4 will be repeated for columns 2-10.

steps.title: Configure P300‑Multi pipette settings
steps.instruction: Select the mount for the P300‑Multi pipette, set the aspirate height to 1 mm from the well bottom (default), and decide whether to perform a second aliquot (if selected, 110 µL will be transferred to the plate in slot 5).

substeps.instruction: Set aspirate from well bottom height to 1 mm.
Choose to perform second aliquot (110 µL to slot 5) if required.

steps.title: Pick up tips (first set)
steps.instruction: Use the P300 8‑Channel GEN2 pipette to pick up a fresh tip rack.

steps.title: Transfer 220 µL supernatant (col 1)
steps.instruction: Aspirate 220 µL of supernatant from Column 1 of the source plate and dispense it into Column 1 of the destination plate.

steps.title: Optional second aliquot transfer
steps.instruction: If the second‑aliquot option is enabled, aspirate 100 µL of supernatant from Column 1 of the source plate and dispense it into Column 1 of the second destination plate (note: the parameter description also mentions 110 µL to the plate in slot 5).

steps.title: Discard used tips (first set)
steps.instruction: Eject the used tips from the P300 8‑Channel GEN2 into the waste bin.

steps.title: Repeat supernatant transfer for columns 2‑10
steps.instruction: For each column from 2 to 10, repeat steps 2‑5: pick up tips, transfer 220 µL supernatant, optionally transfer the second aliquot, and discard tips.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 220 µL supernatant from the current source column to the matching destination column.
If enabled, transfer the second aliquot (100 µL or 110 µL as configured).

steps.title: Pick up tips (second set)
steps.instruction: Use the P300 8‑Channel GEN2 pipette to pick up a new set of tips for the medium transfer.

steps.title: Mix and transfer medium+PrestoBlue (col 1)
steps.instruction: Mix Cell medium with 10 % PrestoBlue, then dispense 100 µL of this mixture into the top of each well in Column 1 of the source plate.

substeps.instruction: Dispense at the top of each well in Column 1.

steps.title: Repeat medium transfer for columns 2‑10
steps.instruction: For each column from 2 to 10, repeat the mixing (if needed) and transfer of 100 µL Cell medium + 10 % PrestoBlue to the top of the wells.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 100 µL of the prepared mixture.
Dispense at the top of each well in the current column.

steps.title: Discard used tips (final)
steps.instruction: Eject the final set of tips into the waste bin.
